facts.title: lock out tag out failure on ZV-7212

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Restore the secondary containment by bund and drainage on ZV-7212 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on ZV-7212 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically setting and proving mechanical seal support systems. ZV-7212 (emergency shutdown valves) is in service for jetty and manifold emergency isolation. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 10 June 2013 an incident occurred on ZV-7212 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during a planned shutdown, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
